newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen's Jan/Feb oil export income hits $166.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Yemen's Jan/Feb oil export income hits $166.5 mln.

text.p: Yemen's income from oil exports in January and February reached $166.5 million compared with full-year 1996 income from oil exports of $958.4 million, an oil official said on Saturday.
The official said local consumption for the first two months of the year stood at 3.51 million barrels while the government's share of exports hovered around 7.83 million barrels.
The government's share of crude produced in Yemen in 1996 reached 28.76 million barrels for local consumption, while its share for export stood at 47.03 million barrels.
